plan.scope: G3a local mono AAC value diagnosis; no production policy or numeric tolerance adoption
criteria: Same decode path repeat must be deterministic
Full decode trimmed at target must match array slice exactly
Compare same float-to-S16 conversion without dither
Compare lag 0 against +/-1 sample controls; do not infer timing from byte equality alone
PNS on/off re-encoding controls only; not a bitstream proof for original source

followupPlan.reason: First PNS-enabled/disabled controls are observationally identical and do not discriminate PNS
followupPlan.criteria: Same deterministic noise input; compare PNS-enabled and disabled encoding; neither labels nor flags alone establish use in original AAC

findings: Original input float differences precede S16 quantization
All repeat-seek outputs deterministic; full-decode target trim exact
First chirp PNS controls do not discriminate in target window, despite different encoded file hashes
Noise PNS on/off controls distinguish persistent decode-history differences from initial overlap transient
No universal 1LSB or amplitude tolerance adopted
Same target PTS and count do not prove initialized decoded values
Original bitstream PNS bands were not directly parsed; mechanism supported rather than proven for original
